opening.text: My skin has turned yellow, and I've been itching all over. The yellowing and the itching have been going on for the past 2 weeks. My stools have been pale, and my urine is very dark. I've smoked a pack of cigarettes a day for 50 years. Before I stopped three years ago, I drank 1 to 2 beers a day for 40 years. Three years ago I had a sudden episode of pain in my upper belly.
